explicit_factorization_not_necessary_doe: the result transfers beyond this grammar and scale

evaluation_order.interpretation: Do not interpret held-out mixed failure as evidence for factorization.
evaluation_order.rule: Use if any shared variant in any seed fails the train-fit adequacy gate, violates allowed-interface constraints, uses a forbidden interface, or breaches sealed-data discipline.

evaluation_order.interpretation: Do not collapse into either a modularity win or a monolithic win.
evaluation_order.rule: Use if train-fit passes but shared_matched and shared_large differ materially by the predeclared capacity criterion, seed spread exceeds the predeclared seed-consistency criterion, or neither practical-effect nor equivalence criteria hold.

evaluation_order.interpretation: Supports a practical generalization advantage for explicit V2 factorization on this fixed grammar and training regime only.
evaluation_order.rule: Use only if shared_matched and shared_large both pass train-fit adequacy and both underperform V2 held-out mixed exact by at least 0.03 in all three seeds without violating seed/capacity consistency rules.

evaluation_order.interpretation: The current R5A-0 V2 grammar can be solved without the explicit transport/color factorization at the tested scale; this does not imply modularity is generally unhelpful.
evaluation_order.rule: Use if a train-adequate shared variant matches V2 within the 0.01 equivalence margin on held-out mixed exact across all three seeds without violating seed consistency.

notes: Thresholds must not be tuned after seeing R5A-1A results.
V2 is a fixed reference for this preregistered comparison; sealed shared outcomes may be used only for final comparison.
Any post-sealed modification creates a new experiment version and a new sealed evaluation surface.

generic_attention_policy: Generic attention is allowed and must not be classified as forbidden merely because it could internally learn correspondence. The prohibition is only against a hand-specified semantic transport/color interface or oracle-equivalent factor channel.
neutrality_statement: This preregistration does not state or assume that a generic shared renderer is expected to pass or fail. It fixes allowed interfaces, forbidden interfaces, thresholds, seed consistency rules, and outcome categories before any R5A-1A shared-renderer training.

shared_large.parameter_budget_rule: predeclare before training; target approximately 4x V2 parameters with at most +/-10% deviation unless implementation arithmetic makes that impossible, in which case record the deviation before training

shared_matched.parameter_budget_rule: predeclare before training; target V2 parameter count with at most +/-10% deviation unless implementation arithmetic makes that impossible, in which case record the deviation before training

equivalence_margin.justification: A 0.01 margin is roughly 58 held-out mixed examples, much larger than exact-metric granularity while still strict for this synthetic deterministic benchmark.
equivalence_margin.must_hold_for: at least one train-adequate shared variant across all three shared seeds

material_capacity_difference.justification: A material matched-vs-large gap indicates capacity sensitivity rather than a clean factorization or non-factorization result.

practically_meaningful_heldout_mixed_eff.justification: Held-out mixed has 5,760 sealed examples across four classes, granularity about 1.74e-4. A 0.03 floor is roughly 173 held-out examples, far above metric granularity and deterministic evaluation noise.
practically_meaningful_heldout_mixed_eff.must_hold_for: both shared_matched and shared_large, all three shared seeds, after train-fit adequacy passes

seed_consistency_criterion.condition_must_hold: for any practical-advantage or equivalence interpretation
seed_consistency_criterion.justification: A 0.02 seed spread is roughly 115 held-out mixed examples, larger than deterministic metric granularity. Larger seed sensitivity prevents collapsing the result into either a modularity or monolithic conclusion.

train_fit_adequacy_gate.applies_to: each shared variant and each seed before interpreting held-out mixed results
train_fit_adequacy_gate.justification: The training split has 43,200 visible examples, so overall exact granularity is about 2.31e-5. Each visible operation has 4,800 train examples, granularity about 2.08e-4. The gate allows small optimization imperfections while excluding controls that have not learned the visible grammar well enough for held-out failure to be interpretable.

sealed_data_discipline.allowed: evaluate the fixed sealed split once for the pre-registered final comparison
sealed_data_discipline.post_sealed_modification_rule: Any post-sealed modification must create a new experiment version and a new sealed evaluation surface.

shared_renderer_allowed_interfaces: same raw grid tokenization and positional encoding as V2
generic cross-attention from output cells to support/query tokens
generic MLPs and final per-cell color logits
generic output-size prediction based only on raw support/query information allowed by the benchmark
generic attention, including attention that may internally learn correspondence without a hand-specified semantic transport/color interface
shared_renderer_forbidden_interfaces: explicit pointer distribution or pointer supervision
sealed-outcome-driven resizing, decoder repair, optimizer changes, threshold changes, margin changes, or variant selection
